16.2.2 3D Texture Volume Rendering - bluevoid.com
Here are the steps for rendering a volume using 3D textures: Load the volume data into a 3D texture. This is done once for a particular data volume. Choose the number of slices, based on the criteria in Section 16.2.5. Usually this matches the texel dimensions of the volume data cube. Find the desired viewpoint and view direction.
